summary: New box Infinitiv: example for sense 1 in Infinitiv (MAC NE Old lady and a bird/17)

data.turoyo: Mәd hawi waxt du+rəstoqo dәmrastqi aʕ+ʕezaṯṯe, əzzə́n lu+ṭuro, komar, ‘Hee! Marke ŭ layko?’ ‘Mənyo?’ ‘Háwәli u+laḥmayḏi!’
data.translation: When the time came to head off, to direct their goats, they went to the hill country, he says, ‘Hey! Where are you going? (lit., ‘from here and to where?’)’ ‘What is it?’ ‘Give me my bread!’
data.ref: MAC NE Old lady and a bird/17

rationale: New Infinitiv box; waxt du rəstoqo names the directing event.

evidence.cite: MAC NE Old lady and a bird/17

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (MAC NE Mem and Zin/26)

data.turoyo: E, áydarbo ktowe? Omar, ‘Ăḷé gəzzino.’ Rawəx ʕal u+səsyayḏe, azzeyo. Səmle lo+səmle lu+babo, lə+ṭrele … lo+kali. Azzé mə́ḷḷela li+ṗirayḏe, omar, ‘Ḳačḳo, Ăḷo u+abrayḏax kəmrastaq ʕal … ʕal Gziro. Izáx! Haḳa madʕaḷḷax … Nawxa Ăḷḷa azzeyo’.
data.translation: Yes, how does it go? He says, ‘By God, I shall go.’ He rode on his horse, he went away. No matter what his father did, he did not let … he did not stay. He went to tell his wife, he says ‘Girl, by God your son is heading to … to Gziro. Go! If you bring him back … Otherwise, by God, he is gone.’

rationale: Thin active Infectum/1 with autonomous directed motion; provisional same active shape as supplied kəmrastaq.

data.turoyo: Mrastaq u+karwan aʕle. Mrastaq karwan, bazərgā́n, aʕle.
data.translation: The caravan came upon him. A caravan, a merchant and his entourage, came upon him.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (65/425)

data.turoyo: Ramazano namardiye lo səmle, mobele u səsyayḏe lu maydan w hawxa ṭawwo mšaḥalle, mobele w mamṭele w naqqa mrastaqle qarʕe ʕal i ʕaskarayḏe.
data.translation: Ramazan, nicht faul, ritt sein Pferd wieder auf den Kampfplatz, machte es gehörig warm, ritt mit ihm vorwärts und zurück, und ließ es dann mit einem Male auf die Soldaten losgaloppieren.

rationale: Thin active Preterit/1; explicit horse-head object and goal.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (67/67)

data.turoyo: Kəmṣanəṭ aʕlayye saʕaye, hakka tarte, gədqom, šote hiye u ʕəraqawo, rowəx ʕal u səsyayḏe, somle sargarm, mbele rišo, tre, tloṯo w naqla gəmrastaqle ʕal i ʕambiqayo arbʕi droʕe, maʕamqalle w arbʕi marawḥole, koqoṭəʕle.
data.translation: Er hört ihnen zwei Stunden lang zu, trinkt den mitgebrachten schnaps, besteigt sein Ross, macht ihm den Kopf warm, reitet mit ihm zwei, drei Mal hin und her, und mit einem Male sprengt er mit ihm stracks auf den Graben zu, den man vierzig Ellen tief und vierzig Ellen breit gemacht hat, und setzt hinüber.

rationale: Thin active Infectum/1; suffixed horse patient demonstrates causing movement.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (67/84)

data.turoyo: Hežnu korowəx, kəmbal u səsyayḏe, mṭele, səmle sargarm, mrastaqle ʕal i ʕambiqayo, maxlaṣla ʕəsri droʕe, zəd mayo.
data.translation: Er steigt wieder auf, reitet mit seinem Pferd hin und her, um ihm den Kopf warm zu machen, dann sprengt er stracks auf den Graben zu, setzt hinüber, zwanzig Ellen weiter als das vorige Mal.

rationale: Thin active Preterit/1; omitted horse patient supplied by preceding clause.

summary: Keep stem I as inherited, despite four radical consonants and the Kurdish rast etymology. The input does not justify relabelling the complete stem Q.
The main sense list's 2 and the parser's separate D1 are two representations of the same Detransitive meaning. Decisions preserve authored global 2; the human view makes the alias explicit.
Active directing can take a horse, horse-head or goats as patient and ʕal as goal. Detransitive has a sole mover with the same ʕal goal, so goal marking alone cannot determine valency.
109/3 is already represented; reassign it rather than adding a second quotation. Repetition of Mrastaq within Joseph/8 likewise yields one example.
